mentions.name: a-mem-mcp
mentions.description: An agentic memory tool built on a new memory model based on Zettelkasten principles. It natively captures connections between atomic ideas and evolves them, and serves as the foundation of the syntopic reading machine approach.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My current approach relies on a tool that I have built recently [0], it's an agentic memory but I am using a new memory model that is based on Zettelkasten principles.

What is really cool about it is that it natively capture connections between atomic ideas and evolve them.
